question: What remains even at the end of śakti-tattva?
premises: With the doctrine established, even at the end of śakti-tattva there is some subtle touch.
Yogis are always desirous of that touch.
inference: A subtle touch persists at the limit of śakti-tattva and is the object of yogic desire.
uncertainties: The exact scope of 'iti sthite naye' is not fully recoverable from this verse alone.
The technical sense of 'saukṣmyabhāk sparśaḥ' may depend on surrounding context.
plain_english: Thus, with the doctrine established, even at the end of the śakti-tattva there is some subtle touch, which yogis always desire.
